capabilities: Visualise a 4-tier hierarchy of ancestors, siblings and children around the current note
Parse Zettelkasten ID formats including dot-notation branching and letter continuations
Navigate the hierarchy by clicking nodes, with Ctrl/Cmd+Click opening new tabs
Adjust depth, branch limit, spacing and auto-update via a control panel and settings
Pan and zoom the canvas-rendered graph with mouse interaction
disambiguation: Not a git branch tool; 'branches' here are hierarchical splits in Zettelkasten note ID numbering.
extras: Not yet in the community plugin directory; manual installation only. README lists known issues with complex ID parsing and mobile responsiveness, and credits Claude for assistance writing the code.
intentEvidence: Unlike generic graph views, this plugin understands Zettelkasten ID numbering systems
problem: Obsidian's generic graph view does not understand Zettelkasten ID numbering, so hierarchical branching between notes is hard to see and navigate.
summary: Graph view that visualises Zettelkasten note hierarchies by parsing ID numbering (e.g. 1114.1a) into colour-coded tiers.
